speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with mental status changes; to begin our assessment, how long have these symptoms been occurring and what specific behaviors are you noticing?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning (suspected). Given the 30 pack-year smoking history and acute altered mental status without trauma or drug use, I must rule out CO poisoning or smoke inhalation. REQUEST TEST: Carboxyhemoglobin level, CBC, CMP, Toxicology Screen. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
